truthBoundary.en: V1 production proof remains valid only for its recorded V1 scope. V2 Cloudflare delivery is verified-production; other V2 claims remain local, pending external verification, or deferred.
truthBoundary.zh: V1 生产证据只在其既有范围内有效。V2 Cloudflare 交付已完成生产验证；其余 V2 状态仍为本地已验证、等待外部验证或延期。

requirement.en: Trace one real browser performance sample through AWS and PostgreSQL, then pause safely.
requirement.zh: 把一条真实浏览器性能样本追踪到 AWS 与 PostgreSQL，并安全暂停消费端。

implementation.en: API Gateway, ingestion Lambda, SNS, SQS/DLQ, ECS Fargate and PostgreSQL preserve request_id.
implementation.zh: API Gateway、接入 Lambda、SNS、SQS/DLQ、ECS Fargate 与 PostgreSQL 保持 request_id 连续。

requirement.en: Serve known routes with Edge SSR and preserve a real 404.
requirement.zh: 已知路由使用 Edge SSR，并为未知路由保留真实 404。

implementation.en: Cloudflare Worker streams SSR, hydrates exact state, and allows one CSR fallback after fatal hydration failure.
implementation.zh: Cloudflare Worker 流式输出 SSR，精确 hydration；严重 hydration 失败时最多执行一次 CSR fallback。

requirement.en: Authenticate wallet ownership without exposing a reusable session credential.
requirement.zh: 验证钱包所有权，同时不暴露可复用的 session 凭据。

implementation.en: Origin-bound challenge-sign-verify consumes the nonce once and returns a Secure HttpOnly cookie.
implementation.zh: 绑定来源的 challenge-sign-verify 只消费一次 nonce，并返回 Secure HttpOnly cookie。

requirement.en: Derive unsigned transaction intent on the server and execute the V2 lifecycle on Sepolia contracts.
requirement.zh: 由服务端生成 unsigned transaction intent，并在 Sepolia 合约执行 V2 生命周期。

implementation.en: Local schemas and contract tests cover intent fields, escrow, settlement, staking and arbitration. The T4 real PostgreSQL chain-state gate passed 1/1; no V2 Sepolia transaction is claimed.
implementation.zh: 本地 schema 与合约测试覆盖 intent 字段、托管、结算、质押和仲裁。T4 真实 PostgreSQL 链状态 Gate 已通过 1/1；当前不声称已有 V2 Sepolia 交易。

requirement.en: Accept chain success only after exact receipt, contract address and event readback.
requirement.zh: 只有精确回读 receipt、合约地址和事件后才接受链上成功。

implementation.en: RPC receipt and log verification is reconciled with Blockscout; a V2 Sepolia transaction has not been submitted.
implementation.zh: 使用 RPC 回执和日志校验并与 Blockscout 对账；尚未提交 V2 Sepolia 交易。

requirement.en: Recall only eligible agents, rank deterministically, and process SQS batches idempotently.
requirement.zh: 只召回合格智能体，确定性排序，并幂等处理 SQS batch。

implementation.en: Go matcher applies exact pgvector recall after hard filters, persists at most two top candidates plus one newcomer, and passed the T5 real PostgreSQL/pgvector integration gate.
implementation.zh: Go matcher 在 hard filters 后执行精确 pgvector recall，最多持久化两个高分候选加一个新人，并已通过 T5 真实 PostgreSQL/pgvector integration Gate。

requirement.en: Train reproducibly without request leakage or executable model payloads.
requirement.zh: 在无 request 泄漏、无可执行模型载荷的前提下可复现训练。

implementation.en: Python uses deterministic grouped OOF/CV and emits candidate-only, schema-validated safe JSON artifacts. Gate recommendation never approves; 33 tests and the independent T6 review passed.
implementation.zh: Python 使用确定性 grouped OOF/CV，并只输出 candidate 状态、经过 schema 校验的安全 JSON artifact。Gate recommendation 不执行审批；33 项测试与 T6 独立 review 均已通过。

requirement.en: Operate replay, HMAC ingestion, DLQ isolation and reversible pause with bounded authority.
requirement.zh: 以受限权限运行 replay、HMAC 接入、DLQ 隔离与可逆暂停。

implementation.en: T7 passed 25 specialized tests, 8 repository-policy tests and the real PostgreSQL replay gate 3/3. Static AWS scanning is option-aware and fail-closed for unknown pre-action options; V2 AWS resources remain undeployed.
implementation.zh: T7 已通过 25 项专项测试、8 项 repository policy 测试与真实 PostgreSQL replay Gate 3/3。AWS 静态扫描可识别 option，并对 action 前未知 option fail-closed；V2 AWS 资源仍未部署。

requirement.en: Gate contracts, TypeScript, Go, Python, Evidence and repository policy, then deliver the accepted merge through Git-integrated Cloudflare Pages.
requirement.zh: 对 contracts、TypeScript、Go、Python、Evidence 和仓库策略执行 Gate，再通过 Git 集成 Cloudflare Pages 交付已验收合并。

implementation.en: PR checks passed before merge. Cloudflare Pages deployed merge commit ae743d8 as production deployment 301df641; public document requests returned SSR 200, the workspace deep link returned 200, and /missing returned 404.
implementation.zh: PR 检查在合并前全部通过。Cloudflare Pages 将合并提交 ae743d8 部署为生产部署 301df641；公开文档请求返回 SSR 200，工作区深链返回 200，/missing 返回 404。

requirement.en: Deploy the remaining V2 AWS runtime and publish fresh external readback.
requirement.zh: 部署剩余的 V2 AWS runtime，并发布新的外部回读。

implementation.en: Cloudflare delivery is independently verified; the V2 AWS runtime remains undeployed and cannot inherit Cloudflare production status.
implementation.zh: Cloudflare 交付已独立验证；V2 AWS runtime 仍未部署，不能继承 Cloudflare 的生产状态。

requirement.en: Add indexed historical queries only when product scale requires them.
requirement.zh: 仅在产品规模需要时加入索引化历史查询。

implementation.en: Phase 2 deliberately uses RPC plus Blockscout; The Graph migration is documented with measurable triggers.
implementation.zh: 二期明确采用 RPC 加 Blockscout；The Graph 迁移使用可衡量触发条件。
